purpose: Isolated S37 F5 follow-up review proposal; not loaded by runtime, not replacing or approving v1. No medication regimen fields. Follow-up no-improvement gate uses a documented baseline encounter/window, PANSS-informed symptom synthesis without any percent-change cutoff, and adequate clozapine-trial context. Outdated baselines and not-assessed severity pause for clarification. Distinct from R7 registration established-case review.

fields.definition: Schizophrenia status for this follow-up encounter, synthesized from registration diagnosis review and current assessment with baseline provenance.
fields.source_locator: project-documents/medical-documents/guideline/STATEMENT-07.md — Identification of Treatment-Resistant Schizophrenia, p. 88; follow-up synthesis uses baseline encounter provenance per history.v1 reconciliation
fields.operationalization: Yes requires documented schizophrenia diagnosis review at this follow-up encounter with baseline encounter attribution; No requires assessment finding schizophrenia not established. Unknown pauses. Copied baseline requires reconciliation. Page notes are never mapping input.
fields.provenance_contract: Clinician-entered structured category with encounter/window, author attribution, baseline encounter reference and assessment record; copied baseline requires reconciliation. Page notes are never mapping input.

fields.definition: Persistent significant symptoms at follow-up, as clinician synthesis informed by PANSS baseline and follow-up item responses with provenance, never a percent-change cutoff alone.
fields.source_locator: project-documents/medical-documents/guideline/STATEMENT-07.md — Identification of Treatment-Resistant Schizophrenia, p. 88; content/assessments/panss.v1.json baseline and follow-up item responses with definition version (S08 validated released PANSS, no owner approval needed)
fields.operationalization: Yes requires clinician-recorded persistent significant symptoms despite treatment, informed by PANSS baseline and follow-up completeness with encounter/window attribution; No requires assessment finding no such persistence with completed PANSS context. No percent-change cutoff is set here; a cutoff requires owner review. Missing PANSS follow-up never maps to Yes. Unknown pauses. Page notes are never mapping input.
fields.provenance_contract: Clinician-entered structured category with encounter/window, author attribution, baseline encounter reference and PANSS definition version/completeness where applicable; copied baseline requires reconciliation. Page notes are never mapping input.

fields.definition: First prior antipsychotic trial categorized by exposure adequacy, response or intolerance; agents and changes only, no regimen details.
fields.source_locator: project-documents/medical-documents/guideline/STATEMENT-07.md — Identification of Treatment-Resistant Schizophrenia, p. 88 (treatment adequacy review)
fields.operationalization: Assessment cites the prior trial agent and window with exposure/response/intolerance category and baseline provenance. Duration, dose and adherence thresholds require owner review; none are set here. Missing assessment pauses and is never coerced to an adequate-trial finding. No dose/route/frequency collected. Page notes are never mapping input.
fields.provenance_contract: Clinician-entered structured category with encounter/window, author attribution and assessment record; copied baseline requires reconciliation. Page notes are never mapping input.

fields.definition: Second prior antipsychotic trial categorized by exposure adequacy, response or intolerance; agents and changes only, no regimen details.
fields.source_locator: project-documents/medical-documents/guideline/STATEMENT-07.md — Identification of Treatment-Resistant Schizophrenia, p. 88 (treatment adequacy review)
fields.operationalization: Assessment cites the prior trial agent and window with exposure/response/intolerance category and baseline provenance. Duration, dose and adherence thresholds require owner review; none are set here. Missing assessment pauses and is never coerced to an adequate-trial finding. No dose/route/frequency collected. Page notes are never mapping input.
fields.provenance_contract: Clinician-entered structured category with encounter/window, author attribution and assessment record; copied baseline requires reconciliation. Page notes are never mapping input.

fields.definition: Whether the two prior trials used different antipsychotic agents.
fields.operationalization: Yes requires two documented distinct trial agents with baseline provenance; No requires documented same-agent trials. Unknown pauses. Agent identities only; no regimen details. Page notes are never mapping input.
fields.provenance_contract: Clinician-entered structured category with encounter/window, author attribution and assessment record; copied baseline requires reconciliation. Page notes are never mapping input.

fields.definition: Whether significant symptoms lasted at least the reviewed observation window, recorded without inventing a new threshold.
fields.source_locator: project-documents/medical-documents/guideline/STATEMENT-07.md — Identification of Treatment-Resistant Schizophrenia, p. 88 (research observation window)
fields.operationalization: Yes/No records the clinician-reviewed observation-window finding with window and baseline attribution. The concrete window operationalization requires owner review. Unknown pauses. Page notes are never mapping input.
fields.provenance_contract: Clinician-entered structured category with encounter/window, author attribution and assessment record; copied baseline requires reconciliation. Page notes are never mapping input.

fields.definition: Whether at least moderate symptoms and functional impairment were recorded at follow-up, without inventing scale cutoffs; not-assessed pauses.
fields.source_locator: project-documents/medical-documents/guideline/STATEMENT-07.md — Identification of Treatment-Resistant Schizophrenia, p. 88 (validated rating scales and functioning); content/assessments/panss.v1.json severity context only, no bands (S08 validated released PANSS, no owner approval needed)
fields.operationalization: Yes/No records the clinician-reviewed severity/impairment finding with scale and window attribution. No mild/moderate/severe score bands are set here; bands require owner review. not_assessed means severity was skipped and pauses for clarification, never coerces to No. Unknown pauses. Page notes are never mapping input.
fields.provenance_contract: Clinician-entered structured category with encounter/window, author attribution and assessment record; copied baseline requires reconciliation. Page notes are never mapping input.

fields.definition: Never, current or previous clozapine treatment at this follow-up encounter; gate true requires CurrentTreatment.
fields.source_locator: project-documents/medical-documents/guideline/STATEMENT-07.md — Initiation of Treatment With Clozapine, pp. 89-90
fields.operationalization: CurrentTreatment requires documented ongoing clozapine at follow-up with encounter/window; NeverTreated/PreviouslyTreated require explicit assessment. Unknown pauses. No dose/route/frequency collected. Page notes are never mapping input.
fields.provenance_contract: Clinician-entered structured category with encounter/window, author attribution and assessment record; copied baseline requires reconciliation. Page notes are never mapping input.

fields.definition: Willingness to discuss clozapine continuation at follow-up; shared decision-making review input used only as defined and collected.
fields.source_locator: project-documents/medical-documents/guideline/STATEMENT-07.md — Initiation of Treatment With Clozapine, pp. 89-90 (shared decision-making)
fields.operationalization: Yes means patient is willing to discuss clozapine after shared discussion; No means unwillingness documented. Missing discussion remains unknown, not No. Operational meaning requires owner review. Page notes are never mapping input.
fields.provenance_contract: Clinician-entered structured category with encounter/window, author attribution and assessment record; copied baseline requires reconciliation. Page notes are never mapping input.

fields.definition: Availability of a clozapine monitoring and follow-up plan per current prescribing information at this follow-up encounter.
fields.source_locator: project-documents/medical-documents/guideline/STATEMENT-07.md — Monitoring for Side Effects During Treatment With Clozapine, pp. 90-93
fields.operationalization: Yes means a monitoring and follow-up plan is available per current prescribing information; No means no such plan available. Operational meaning requires owner review. Page notes are never mapping input.
fields.provenance_contract: Clinician-entered structured category with encounter/window, author attribution and assessment record; copied baseline requires reconciliation. Page notes are never mapping input.

fields.definition: Appropriateness of a clozapine discussion at follow-up represented as a scenario assumption for review.
fields.source_locator: project-documents/medical-documents/guideline/STATEMENT-07.md — Initiation of Treatment With Clozapine, pp. 89-90
fields.operationalization: Yes/No records the clinician-reviewed appropriateness finding with encounter attribution. Operational meaning requires owner review. Unknown pauses. Page notes are never mapping input.
fields.provenance_contract: Clinician-entered structured category with encounter/window, author attribution and assessment record; copied baseline requires reconciliation. Page notes are never mapping input.

fields.definition: Clinician-determined urgent safety concern at this follow-up encounter from saved structured urgent inputs; displayed independently of estimation latency.
fields.source_locator: project-documents/medical-documents/guideline/STATEMENT-07.md — Monitoring for Side Effects During Treatment With Clozapine, pp. 90-93
fields.operationalization: Present means clinician identifies an urgent safety concern from saved structured urgent inputs during current assessment; Absent means urgent assessment was completed without identified concern. This banner renders from saved inputs independently of estimation latency and is never a model-computed risk percentage. Unknown pauses. Page notes are never mapping input.
fields.provenance_contract: Clinician-entered structured category with encounter/window, author attribution and assessment record; copied baseline requires reconciliation. Page notes are never mapping input.

fields.definition: Concern about adherence, smoking or caffeine changes, interactions, concentrations or sample timing at follow-up.
fields.source_locator: project-documents/medical-documents/guideline/STATEMENT-07.md — Use of Clozapine Levels During Treatment With Clozapine, p. 90
fields.operationalization: Yes means clinician records an exposure-interpretation concern with factor attribution; No means review found none. Unknown pauses. No regimen details collected. Page notes are never mapping input.
fields.provenance_contract: Clinician-entered structured category with encounter/window, author attribution and assessment record; copied baseline requires reconciliation. Page notes are never mapping input.

fields.definition: Adequacy of the current clozapine trial at follow-up represented as a scenario assumption for review, without inventing thresholds.
fields.operationalization: Yes/No records the clinician-reviewed adequacy finding for the current clozapine course with window and baseline attribution. Target dose, level and duration thresholds require owner review; none are set here. Inadequate exposure never coerces to adequate. Unknown pauses. Page notes are never mapping input.
fields.provenance_contract: Clinician-entered structured category with encounter/window, author attribution and assessment record; copied baseline requires reconciliation. Page notes are never mapping input.

fields.definition: Residual symptoms during current clozapine treatment at follow-up, as clinician synthesis informed by PANSS baseline and follow-up comparison without any percent-change cutoff.
fields.source_locator: project-documents/medical-documents/guideline/STATEMENT-07.md — Optimizing Treatment With Clozapine, p. 94; content/assessments/panss.v1.json baseline and follow-up item responses with definition version (S08 validated released PANSS, no owner approval needed)
fields.operationalization: Yes means clinician records residual symptoms during current clozapine treatment with baseline/follow-up and window attribution, informed by completed PANSS context; No means review found no residual symptoms with completed PANSS context. No percent-change cutoff is set here; a cutoff requires owner review. Missing PANSS follow-up never maps to Yes and never maps to No. Unknown pauses. Page notes are never mapping input.
fields.provenance_contract: Clinician-entered structured category with encounter/window, author attribution, baseline encounter reference and PANSS definition version/completeness where applicable; copied baseline requires reconciliation. Page notes are never mapping input.

fields.definition: Baseline signed encounter chosen as the comparison for no-improvement review, with encounter identity and window attribution; gate-only applicability input, not a CPT estimation input.
fields.source_locator: content/history/history.v1.json — reconciliation_contract (follow-up copies require reconciliation) and provenance_contract; project-documents/medical-documents/guideline/STATEMENT-07.md — Optimizing Treatment With Clozapine, p. 94 (follow-up comparison needs a baseline)
fields.operationalization: documented_current requires an explicitly chosen signed baseline encounter with identity, visit time and PANSS version recorded and reconciled at this follow-up; outdated means the recorded baseline was superseded or flagged outdated by the clinician; missing means no baseline chosen. Outdated or missing pauses for clarification and never silently skips review. Page notes are never mapping input.
fields.provenance_contract: Clinician-entered structured category with encounter/window, author attribution and baseline encounter identity; copied baseline requires reconciliation. Page notes are never mapping input.

fields.definition: Whether the chosen baseline window is still current for comparison at this follow-up; gate-only applicability input, not a CPT estimation input.
fields.source_locator: content/history/history.v1.json — reconciliation_contract and periods; project-documents/medical-documents/guideline/STATEMENT-07.md — Optimizing Treatment With Clozapine, p. 94
fields.operationalization: current requires clinician review that the baseline window remains valid for comparison at this follow-up; outdated requires explicit clinician flag that the baseline is too old or superseded and pauses for clarification with a fresh baseline choice. No recency threshold in days/weeks is set here; a threshold requires owner review. Missing validity pauses. Page notes are never mapping input.
fields.provenance_contract: Clinician-entered structured category with encounter/window, author attribution and baseline window attribution; copied baseline requires reconciliation. Page notes are never mapping input.

fields.definition: PANSS baseline completeness for the chosen baseline encounter; gate-only applicability input recording whether a baseline score exists, not the score itself.
fields.source_locator: content/assessments/panss.v1.json — completeness and scoring contract (S08 validated released PANSS, no owner approval needed); project-documents/medical-documents/guideline/STATEMENT-07.md — Optimizing Treatment With Clozapine, p. 94
fields.operationalization: completed requires a complete PANSS at baseline per the released definition version with encounter attribution; missing means no baseline PANSS recorded; not_assessed means baseline PANSS was skipped. Missing or not_assessed pauses for clarification and is never treated as no improvement. No percent-change cutoff is set here. Page notes are never mapping input.
fields.provenance_contract: Clinician-entered structured category with encounter/window, author attribution, PANSS definition version and baseline encounter reference; copied baseline requires reconciliation. Page notes are never mapping input.

fields.definition: PANSS follow-up completeness at the current encounter; gate-only applicability input recording whether a follow-up score exists, not the score itself.
fields.source_locator: content/assessments/panss.v1.json — completeness and scoring contract (S08 validated released PANSS, no owner approval needed); project-documents/medical-documents/guideline/STATEMENT-07.md — Optimizing Treatment With Clozapine, p. 94
fields.operationalization: completed requires a complete PANSS at follow-up per the released definition version; missing means no follow-up PANSS recorded. A missing follow-up score is never treated as no improvement and pauses for clarification. No percent-change cutoff is set here. Page notes are never mapping input.
fields.provenance_contract: Clinician-entered structured category with encounter/window, author attribution and PANSS definition version; copied baseline requires reconciliation. Page notes are never mapping input.

retained_history_v1: Twelve original v1 fields and runtime remain unchanged; this separately versioned adjunct proposes 15 node-mapped CPT-context categories plus 4 gate-only baseline/PANSS applicability categories (19 total), none approved.
